title: Xerxes the second
summary: Raleigh names Xerxes the second in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Xerxes the second, sonne of Artaxerxes Longimanus, seeming with his brother Sogdianus to haue bene the sonnes of Hester, who held the Kingdome but a moneth or two. He is not Xerxes who inuaded Greece. The one-word title would fold onto that record, so the title is three words. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
